cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
t3code 日增 1,659
控制台赛道最稳
cover.dek: t3code 近 14 天日增一直在 +1,005 到 +1,674 之间，星数已到 69,089。同类的 orca 连续 139 天日增达标，多 Agent 控制台是眼下最稳的一条线。
cover.title_en:
t3code adds 1,659 stars a day
The steadiest lane is the agent console
cover.dek_en: For 14 days t3code has gained between +1,005 and +1,674 stars daily, and it now sits at 69,089. Its peer orca has hit its daily mark for 139 straight days, so multi-agent consoles are the most reliable trend on the board.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: Unfinished-Bench 里 98.3% 的违规，发生在规则已经显示之后。
stickers.text_en: In Unfinished-Bench, 98.3% of rule violations happened after the rule was already shown.

stickers.title: 回落中
stickers.text_en: rust-anything has 7,206 stars, and its daily gain has slipped to +912.

stickers.title: 新形态
stickers.text: phonedriver、pinky 等手机控制 agent 连续多天上涨
stickers.text_en: Phone-control agents like phonedriver and pinky have been climbing for several days running.
